ko.executive_summary: Qualcomm announced double-digit price increases for Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 due to higher supplier costs, with expanded partnerships including Samsung for Snapdragon production. Samsung and Broadcom signed a landmark $200 billion HBM and AI semiconductor deal, while Micron is lobbying to block Apple's Chinese memory chip plans.
key_facts: Qualcomm planning double-digit Snapdragon price increase
Samsung and Broadcom $200 billion HBM and AI semiconductor deal
Micron lobbying Trump to block Apple Chinese memory chip plan

implications.text: Higher Snapdragon prices will increase Android phone manufacturing costs
Deepened Snapdragon ties strengthen Samsung's chipset production role
Micron competition heating up over Apple memory sourcing strategies

ko.counterpoint: Price increases may be limited by competitive pressure from MediaTek and other ARM competitors.
